statements.label: supported
statements.text: Compared with other sequenced genomes, the chromosome-scale little skate genome retains many ancestral jawed vertebrate features, among them numerous ancient microchromosomes.
statements.evidence: Analysis of a high-quality chromosome-scale genome sequence for the little skate shows that it preserves many ancestral jawed vertebrate features compared with other sequenced genomes, including numerous ancient microchromosomes.
statements.note: The genome analysis reports that the little skate preserves many ancestral jawed vertebrate features, including numerous ancient microchromosomes, compared with other sequenced genomes.

statements.label: not_addressed

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Functionally blocking planar cell polarity signalling led to smaller anterior fins, marking this pathway as a major contributor to batoid fin shape.

statements.note: Inhibiting planar cell polarity signalling reduced anterior fin size, which the abstract takes as confirmation that the pathway is a major contributor to batoid fin morphology.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Zebrafish reporter assays confirmed that a fin-specific enhancer contacting several hoxa genes can activate transcription in the anterior fin.
statements.evidence: We also identified a fin-specific enhancer that interacts with several hoxa genes, consistent with the redeployment of hox gene expression in anterior pectoral fins, and confirmed its potential to activate transcription in the anterior fin using zebrafish reporter assays.
statements.note: The abstract describes a fin-specific enhancer that interacts with several hoxa genes and whose potential to activate anterior-fin transcription was confirmed in zebrafish reporter assays.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In each of the two molluscs studied, a gastropod and a polyplacophoran, Hox expression fell into two categories.

statements.note: The abstract states that Hox expression in both the gastropod and the polyplacophoran can be divided into 2 categories.

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The dorsal Hox expression category, closely linked to shell formation, was divergent between the gastropod and the polyplacophoran.

statements.label: not_addressed

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported

statements.label: supported
